findings.issue: The genuinely new content in lines 194-199 and 215-229 is the pointwise converse of the Jordan lemmas (`unipotentPart g = g → IsUnipotentPoint g`, `semisimplePart g = 1 → IsUnipotentPoint g`), proved inline only for `K = AlgebraicClosure k` even though the argument uses only `Point.isUnipotent_pointsAction_unipotentPart` and `Point.semisimplePart_mul_unipotentPart`, both stated for an arbitrary perfect extension field.

summary: The three characterization theorems are stated only for the smoothness-conjoined property, with the smoothness conjunct provably inert (each proof is `and_congr_right fun _ ↦ …`), so the standalone `unipotentCommHopfAlgProperty` that the PR advertises as its reusable component gets no criteria at all. The pointwise Jordan converses are also proved inline only for `K = AlgebraicClosure k` although the argument needs only a perfect extension field.
